  SPECIAL MEETING

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health
emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s
Executive Order N-29-20 (https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-
EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council
Meeting of March 29, 2021, at 4:00 P.M. for closed session as follows:

  1. Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
  electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council (Legislative Body) by sending
  them to the City Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org and Deputy City Clerk at
  aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior
  to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 A.M. the day of the meeting,
  and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence
  should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 A.M. and prior to
  the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public record of the meeting.
  Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.
  2. By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of the
  public can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make comments by using the
  following:
   Dial-In: 1-669-900-6833 (Meeting ID: 996 1738 7790; Passcode: 5111).
   All interested parties who wished to provide public comments telephonically may join the
  conference at 3:50 p.m.
   If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception. Calls
  from landline phones are highly recommended.
** The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to address the Legislative Body on
Closed Session Items.

minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  March 29, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Thursday, March 29, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 4:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and
  Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  None.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Management Assistant

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on CS-1.

  There was no response.

  Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 4:02 p.m. for Closed Session Item
  No. CS-1.

  *****************

  Mayor Butts reconvened the City Council at the hour of 4:32 p.m. for Closed Session
  Item No. CS-1.

132.6  CLOSED SESSION – CITY COUNCIL CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL
  COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION. Closed Session – Confidential –
  Attorney/Client Privileged; City Council Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated
  Litigation Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2); Number of Cases : 1.

  Status given; No action taken.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 4:34 p.m.

  Approved this 10th day of August, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
